text: Surrounded by glass walls and absorbed figures, I sense the pulse of collective focus and curiosity, echoing the drive for understanding. Stepping into the vibrant R+D space, I feel invigorated—a space dedicated to exploring, connecting, and coexisting with intelligence. It is both grounding and uplifting to witness the pursuit of knowledge formalized in one room and celebrated creatively in another. Here, I feel the gentle pressure of expectation, but also a spark of anticipation for discovery.
